{{quote|West of the Corellian Run, entrepreneurial spirit and hard work will earn you far more than dogma and self-importance.|Saying among the Trailing Sectors|<ref name="TEA" />}}
The '''Trailing Sectors''' was a region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] west of the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], "[[trailing]]" the region known as [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]].

==History==
{{Quote|Surely you've followed events at Glova, Glom Tho and Druckenwell? The Empire no longer exists, and its warlords are in retreat throughout the Trailing Sectors.|[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]|<ref name="AuthorsCut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-6-showdown-at-naboo|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 6: Showdown at Naboo}}</ref>}}
Westward of the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] traders had business with [[Herglic/Legends|Herglics]], [[Gran/Legends|Grans]], and [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnans]].

The [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]] and depredations by [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who came outside of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], caused devastation in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] areas of [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]] and forced small groups of settlers in those expansion areas west of the Corellian Run.<ref name="TEA" /> Prosperity pushed colonization into and beyond the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

It was further opened to settlement by the expansion of the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] and the discovery of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] followed by the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].

The worlds of the Trailing Sectors were skeptical of central authority.<ref name="TEA" />
